movement_profile.formation_and_space: Two facing lines with dancers filling the space between.

signature_moves.description: Choreographed movements while holding wooden replica rifles.
signature_moves.name: Rifle manipulation

signature_moves.description: Young girls swing their hair in time to the music.
signature_moves.name: Hair swinging

music_profile.musical_form: Dual chorus led by a main singer.

basic_steps: Form two facing lines of men.
Chant Nabati poetry in an antiphonal manner.
Perform choreographed movements in the space between the rows.
Manipulate wooden replica rifles in rhythm with the music.
Girls swing hair in time to the music.
teaching.formation: Two facing lines with dancers in the middle.
teaching.level_notes: Inclusive of all ages and social classes.
